items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Joe Glaser‟s office handled my affairs and they‟re the ones [who] booked my trio at Hickory House.

ctx.x: So, well, I mean, that … the school asked the booking agent in New York called Joe Glaser—the biggest one [client] was, I think, Armstrong. Anyway, Joe Glaser‟s office handled my affairs and they‟re the ones [who] booked my trio at Hickory House. I said this yesterday, but I really wanted to go to a place like Birdland, you know.
